page.layout: One column of running text, top to bottom. Below it, a woodcut ornament (fleuron) in the centre of the page, with no text. At the right foot, the catchword "EPI." No marginal notes.

main_text.p: beatur,profecto ci[?] imprimis deberi cum nemo sanæ men-tis non fatebitur,á quo primum in animis nostris semen cjusjactum est,& cujus ductu,non modó humaniorum literarum,sed etiam veræ solidæque pietatis stadium sumus ingressi. Quamobrem, ego licet seriús quám oportuit,fructum huncaliquem laborum meorum,atq; etiam tuorum,tibi offero, & Commentarium hunc meum in Pauli Apostoli ad Thessalonicenses Epistolam priorem, in tuo nomine exire volo;idque eo fine,ut si quid ex meis scriptis boni ad quosvis perveniet,ii bona ex parte abs te agnoscant illud emanasse. Vale,Edinburgi,1598. 14. Ca-lend.Augusti.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text is an engraved fleuron, not printed text, so it is not transcribed. The right edge of the scan is dark and cut off; the last letters of "EPI." may be incomplete. Long s has been rendered as s throughout; where the scan shows a long s (looks like f) it was normalised, while true f (e.g. "fatebitur", "fructum", "fine", "offero") was kept. "ci" after "profecto" is doubtful and marked [?]. Lines are run together as printed on the scan, with spacing around commas kept as printed.
